title: Prepare the operating cash flow section of the statement of cash flows using the direct method

items.concept: Reconstruct period-end adjusting JEs (emphasis), initial recognition and disposal/settlement JEs, AR inventory AP interest tax schedules, full direct-method operating section plus NI reconciliation
Number-variant twin—direct-method operating section; period-end discount amortization AJ; mixed WC signs; land and equipment disposals; required NI reconciliation
Period-end adjusting JE emphasis—record year-end AJs (accruals, prepaids, depreciation, BDE, premium) and convert each cash-relevant line to direct-method operating classes
Classification/presentation—major direct-method operating cash classes; depreciation and equipment gain do not appear as direct lines
Period-end discount amortization AJ and correct computation of cash paid for interest under the direct method
